people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!
translations.bsb: Then the Israelites declared to Moses, “Look, we are perishing! We are lost; we are all lost!
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we perish, we are undone, we are all undone.
